description: Convert one grade between two grading systems using the real band-standing logic (Bavarian formula for inverted scales, linear fallback), via the US 4.0 baseline. Give grading-system ids to read bands from the database, or max_scale/min_pass numbers for a numeric conversion.

source_grade.description: Grade label (e.g. 'A', '8.5', 'First Class') in the source system

source_mappings.description: Source grade mappings to use directly, instead of the database

source_max_scale.description: Source scale maximum (e.g. 10 for India 10-point, 4 for US)

source_system_id.description: grading_systems id for the source system

target_mappings.description: Target grade mappings to use directly, instead of the database

target_system_id.description: grading_systems id for the target system

name: convert_grade
